title: The push-forward of an oriented multiplicity-one C¹ piece by a bi-Lipschitz C¹ bijection with injective derivative is an integer multiplicity current of mass at most the area of the image (Simon 6.2.24(3), 6.3.9 for C¹ pieces)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ with m ≥ 1; N ⊆ ℝ^P an embedded m-dimensional C¹ submanifold with orientation ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_m(ℝ^P) (IsOrientation m N ξ: ξ is continuous on N and ξ(x) is a unit orientation of T_xN for x ∈ N); W ⊆ ℝ^P open with H^m(N ∩ W) < ∞; Φ : ℝ^P → ℝ^P a C¹ bijection with DΦ(x) injective for every x, Λ-Lipschitz and Λ-antilipschitz for some Λ ≥ 0. Then there is an integer multiplicity current D ∈ 𝒟_m(ℝ^P) such that for every ω ∈ 𝒟^m(ℝ^P) the function x ↦ ⟨ω(Φ(x))∘DΦ(x), ξ(x)⟩ = ξ(x)(ω(Φ(x)).compContinuousLinearMap(DΦ(x))) is H^m-integrable on N ∩ W and D(ω) = ∫_{N∩W} ξ(x)(ω(Φ(x))∘DΦ(x)) dH^m(x), and M_{W′}(D) ≤ H^m(Φ(N ∩ W) ∩ W′) for every W′ ⊆ ℝ^P (M_{W′} = massOn, H^m = μHE[m]).
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (N W : Set (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P m) (Φ : Euclid P → Euclid P) (Λ : NNReal), 1 ≤ m → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m N → IsOrientation m N ξ → IsOpen W → μHE[m] (N ∩ W) ≠ ∞ → ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ → Bijective Φ → (∀ x, Injective (fderiv ℝ Φ x)) → LipschitzWith Λ Φ → AntilipschitzWith Λ Φ → ∃ D : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, IsIntegerMultiplicity D ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, Integrable (fun x => ξ x (((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) (Φ x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ Φ x))) (μHE[m].restrict (N ∩ W)) ∧ D ω = ∫ x in N ∩ W, ξ x (((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) (Φ x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ Φ x)) ∂μHE[m]) ∧ ∀ W' : Set (Euclid P), D.massOn W' ≤ μHE[m] (Φ '' (N ∩ W) ∩ W')
